summary: The reset election now uses the selected subscription cohort, with a focused regression test covering a blocked selected account and healthy unselected account.

evidence: account-routing.ts now derives selectedCodexSubscriptionPool, rejects candidates outside it, and evaluates fullCohortExhausted over that same selected cohort.
